task_instruction: Rewrite each direct yes/no question as a reported question.
paragraphs: Sam visits a tattoo studio to ask about a small design. Artist Riley begins the consultation with a few questions. Riley asked Sam, {{red:Do you want a small tattoo?}} {{mask_1}} Riley also asked, {{red:Have you chosen a design?}} {{mask_2}} Sam said that a small bird might work. Riley asked, {{red:Do you want the bird on your arm?}} {{mask_3}} Then Riley asked, {{red:Is this your first tattoo?}} {{mask_4}}

Riley explains that the studio discusses size and placement before making an appointment. Riley asked Sam, {{red:Would you like to see some design examples?}} {{mask_5}} Sam said yes. Riley asked, {{red:Can you bring your own drawing?}} {{mask_6}} Sam had a sketch on a phone. Riley asked, {{red:Have you saved the drawing on your phone?}} {{mask_7}} Sam showed the sketch. Riley asked, {{red:Are you happy with this size?}} {{mask_8}}

They talk about preparation and studio procedures. Riley asked Sam, {{red:Do you have any questions about the appointment?}} {{mask_9}} Sam asked how long it might take. Riley asked, {{red:Will you have enough time this afternoon?}} {{mask_10}} Sam had another appointment later. Riley asked, {{red:Did you read the studio's information sheet?}} {{mask_11}} Sam had read it that morning. Riley asked, {{red:Can you contact us if you need to change the appointment?}} {{mask_12}}

Before they finish, Riley reviews the design details. Riley asked Sam, {{red:Does the bird need any changes?}} {{mask_13}} Sam wanted to make one line thinner. Riley asked, {{red:Would you prefer a different position?}} {{mask_14}} Sam preferred the original position. Riley asked, {{red:Are you comfortable with the final design?}} {{mask_15}} Sam said yes. Riley asked, {{red:Have you checked the spelling in the design?}} {{mask_16}} Sam checked it carefully.

Sam writes a short summary after leaving the studio. Riley had asked whether Sam wanted a small tattoo and whether Sam had chosen a design. Sam notes that Riley asked, {{red:Do you understand that you can take more time to decide?}} {{mask_17}} Riley also asked, {{red:Would you like to book another consultation?}} {{mask_18}} Sam decided to think about it. At the end, Riley asked, {{red:Can we send you the appointment details by email?}} {{mask_19}} Sam agreed. Riley asked, {{red:Will you let us know your decision next week?}} {{mask_20}} Sam planned to reply after considering the design.
